question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

With no major contenders locked in and ideological balance between progressive and moderate approaches unresolved, minor polling shifts, endorsements, or entry decisions could quickly reorder probabilities before formal campaigns begin.

Recent DNC approval of a 2028 primary calendar starting with South Carolina on January 22 elevates the influence of Black, Latino, and union voters, a shift that could advantage candidates with demonstrated strength in those coalitions. AOC’s comments that she has not ruled out a presidential bid, alongside polls showing her atop early surveys, have supported her narrow lead, while Newsom’s high-profile opposition role against the current administration sustains his position. Ossoff benefits from perceptions of him as a fresh Senate voice. With no major contenders locked in and ideological balance between progressive and moderate approaches unresolved, minor polling shifts, endorsements, or entry decisions could quickly reorder probabilities before formal campaigns begin.
